messages:
Taylor Nguyen: Hi team  unpacked MacBook on the road and MDM enrollment fails on the hotel Wi-Fi (captive portal). Setup assistant stalls at 'Applying profile'. FileVault started but shows 'paused'. Any quick tips?
Priya (IT): welcome! captive portals often break the initial MDM push. try a phone hotspot or tethered USB. serial?
Taylor Nguyen: serial C02VY7ZZ9KLM. switched to phone hotspot and enrollment progressed but then hung on 'Installing profiles' for 8 mins. Docker also needs admin and I don't have sudo.
mdm-bot: Enrollment attempt for C02VY7ZZ9KLM: initial network failed; retry via hotspot succeeded. Profiles installed: 3/4. FileVault status: paused (low battery).
it-ops-bot: Reminder: temporary admin requires a ticket. Template: "Temporary admin 72h for <serial>  reason".
Taylor Nguyen: plugged in power, resumed encryption (now 7%). opened ticket IT-2305: "Temporary admin 72h for C02VY7ZZ9KLM for Docker and dev setup".
Priya (IT): saw IT-2305, approving 72h sudo now. you should get an elevation prompt after logout/login. avoid large OS upgrades until imaging team approves.
Taylor Nguyen: got the admin elevation, installed Docker and Homebrew. FileVault completed to 100% while I was installing. thanks for the quick help!
Priya (IT): great! admin will auto-revoke after 72h. i'll escrow the FileVault key and confirm device shows 'Compliant' in MDM. ping me if anything else blocks onboarding.
Taylor Nguyen: all green, cloning onboarding repo now. appreciate it :raised_hands:
